description: This is a Java source file defining the OrderTotal entity class, which models order total details such as tax, shipping, and total amounts in an e-commerce system. It includes mappings to a database table and fields representing various attributes of an order total.

classes.name: OrderTotal
classes.description: Entity class representing total monetary amounts related to an order, such as tax or shipping, with database mappings and related attributes.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the order total.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the order total.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Retrieves the title associated with this order total, such as 'Shipping' or 'Tax'.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title associated with the order total.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Gets the textual description or details for the order total.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the textual description for the order total.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the monetary value of this order total.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the monetary value of this order total.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Retrieves the module associated with this total, possibly indicating the component responsible.

methods.name: setModule
methods.description: Sets the module responsible for this total.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Returns the display sort order for this order total.

methods.name: setSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the display sort order for this order total.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves the associated Order object.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Sets the associated Order object.

methods.name: getOrderTotalCode
methods.description: Returns the code representing the type of total, such as 'SHIPPING' or 'TAX'.

methods.name: setOrderTotalCode
methods.description: Sets the code representing the type of total.

methods.name: getOrderValueType
methods.description: Gets the order value type enum (e.g., one-time, recurring).

methods.name: setOrderValueType
methods.description: Sets the order value type enum.

methods.name: getOrderTotalType
methods.description: Retrieves the total type enum, indicating the category of total.

methods.name: setOrderTotalType
methods.description: Sets the total type enum.
